THT component preparation

S-300B Radial Lead Forming & Taping Machine

Prepare loose radial components for automatic insertion. The S-300B forms the leads to a specified pitch and secures the parts on carrier tape for box or reel packing.

Operating sequence

From loose components to carrier tape

Choose the forming tool around the component body, lead spacing and finished tape drawing. These three dimensions determine how the taped component will enter the insertion machine.

Feed and orient

The bowl presents loose parts to the forming station. Supply samples in the orientation and condition in which they will arrive.

Form the leads

Tooling sets the spacing between the leads. Standard formed pitches are 2.5, 3.5 and 5.0 mm.

Tape and pack

The machine secures the parts at a regular pitch. Specify a box or reel output to suit the next operation.

Application review

Before you specify

Can the machine check component values?

The optional test station can be configured with a suitable tester to check resistance or capacitance and sort parts. Specify the value range and rejection criteria.

What should I send for tooling review?

Send a component drawing, sample parts and the target tape drawing. Include lead pitch, polarity or orientation, tape hole pitch and packing format.
